title: Machining demonstration schedule

documents.title: Production planning note
documents.text:
Each customer demonstration needs an operator and a setup technician. The same person cannot fill both roles in one demonstration. Book the entire slot, even if the machine will run for only part of it.

A slot marked REVIEW is not open for a demonstration until the safety lead sends written approval. You may offer a READY slot immediately if both roles are covered. For customers who cannot move their appointment, the training room may be used for a sample inspection, but it cannot be used for a live machine demonstration.
documents.textZh:
每場客戶示範都需要一位操作員與一位設置技術員。同一場示範中，一人不能兼任兩個角色。即使機器只在時段的一部分運轉，也須預約完整時段。

標為 REVIEW（待審）的時段要等安全主管發出書面核准，才能安排示範。若兩個角色皆有人負責，就可立即提供標為 READY（就緒）的時段。若顧客無法改期，可使用訓練室檢視樣品，但不可在那裡做機器實機示範。

documents.title: Coordinator’s message
documents.text:
Marta can operate all morning on Wednesday, but the technician assigned to 9:00 has called in sick. The technician for 10:00 can still take that slot. There is also a technician available at 11:00; that slot is listed as REVIEW, and the approval has not come in.

The 9:00 and 10:00 slots are listed as READY. Dana’s group asked to see the machine running, and they can move their Wednesday appointment to any morning slot. Another group can only come at 9:00 and specifically asked to inspect finished samples, not see the machine run. Please let me know what we can offer now.
documents.textZh:
瑪塔星期三整個上午都能操作機器，但原定九點到場的設置技術員請病假。十點的設置技術員仍可負責原時段。十一點也有技術員能到場，但該時段標為 REVIEW，目前尚未收到核准。

九點和十點都標為 READY。黛娜一行人希望看機器運轉，可把星期三的預約移到當天上午任何時段。另一組只能九點來，且特別說只想檢視完成的樣品，不是要看機器運轉。請告訴我目前能提供什麼安排。

每場客戶示範都需要一位操作員與一位設置技術員。同一場示範中，一人不能兼任兩個角色。即使機器只在時段的一部分運轉，也須預約完整時段。
